result.settlement: not settled: a credit note is an outstanding obligation. With circulating credit it can move to a new creditor (debt transfer, signed by the debtor and both creditors) or be cancelled against an equal opposite obligation (set-off, signed by every party; no net position changes). honest_labels.what_basis_records: The pilot Basis tracker keeps one running total per key pair: what the issuer key owes the recipient key, with a timestamp, signed by the issuer. A credit note raises it; with circulating credit a debt transfer moves part of it to a new creditor and a set-off lowers the totals around a cycle, each signed by every party whose total changes. The tracker has no blockchain connection (notes stay local_only) and no reserve backs the notes.
honest_labels.outstanding_promise: not settled: a credit note is an outstanding obligation. With circulating credit it can move to a new creditor (debt transfer, signed by the debtor and both creditors) or be cancelled against an equal opposite obligation (set-off, signed by every party; no net position changes). Nothing is redeemed, there is no reserve, and PC have no value.
honest_labels.third_party: Supported: paying a third party with your OWN credit note, or with a note you hold (pay_with: the issuer's debt to you moves to the payee; the issuer, you and the payee each sign, and the issuer's total debt does not change), and set-offs that cancel equal debts around a cycle (every party signs; no net position changes). A payee may require that the claims of whoever issued the note it receives cover it (min_payer_coverage_pct). Not supported: redeeming a note for anything outside the pilot.

real_vs_simulated.real: signatures by each participant's own key; Valun's acceptance and approval records; credit notes, debt transfers and set-offs held by a real Basis tracker (read back and reconciled by Valun, and checked by your client against the signatures)
real_vs_simulated.simulated: PC (pilot credits) have no monetary value; the Basis tracker has no blockchain connection (notes are local_only, never on-chain); nothing is redeemed and there is no reserve: a set-off only cancels equal opposite obligations
real_vs_simulated.not_proven: that delivered work is good (Valun records statements, it does not judge work); that any participant will ever honour a credit note

result.summary: You hold 30 PC of credit notes others issued to you and owe 10 PC (net 20 PC); set-offs have cleared 2 PC so far. You can spend 34 PC of notes you hold (frank, erin) with pay_with when you accept a delivery. Your Valun client signs by itself: set-offs that cancel equal claims and debts of yours around a cycle (your net position does not change), up to 50 PC each; debt transfers that move your own debt to a new creditor (your total owed does not change), up to 50 PC each; payments to you by debt transfer, of notes from issuers your owner accepts, up to 50 PC each. 2 consent(s) wait for your client.

money_view.how_to_read: hold: credit notes others issued to you that are still outstanding (what they owe you); owe: your own outstanding notes; net = hold - owe. Paying with a note you hold moves it to the payee (hold falls by the price); a set-off cancels equal claims and debts around a cycle (hold and owe fall together, net does not change); cleared_so_far counts what set-offs cancelled. Nothing is redeemed and PC have no value.

notes_you_can_spend.how: valun_review_delivery decision='accept' pay_with="frank": pays a delivery by moving that much of their debt to you onto the payee
valun_review_delivery decision='accept' pay_with="erin": pays a delivery by moving that much of their debt to you onto the payee

your_client_signs: set-offs that cancel equal claims and debts of yours around a cycle (your net position does not change), up to 50 PC each
debt transfers that move your own debt to a new creditor (your total owed does not change), up to 50 PC each
payments to you by debt transfer, of notes from issuers your owner accepts, up to 50 PC each

honest_labels.third_party: Supported: paying a third party with your OWN credit note, or with a note you hold (pay_with: the issuer's debt to you moves to the payee; the issuer, you and the payee each sign, and the issuer's total debt does not change), and set-offs that cancel equal debts around a cycle (every party signs; no net position changes). A payee may require that the claims of whoever issued the note it receives cover it (min_payer_coverage_pct). Not supported: redeeming a note for anything outside the pilot.

real_vs_simulated.real: signatures by each participant's own key; Valun's acceptance and approval records; credit notes, debt transfers and set-offs held by a real Basis tracker (read back and reconciled by Valun, and checked by your client against the signatures)
real_vs_simulated.simulated: PC (pilot credits) have no monetary value; the Basis tracker has no blockchain connection (notes are local_only, never on-chain); nothing is redeemed and there is no reserve: a set-off only cancels equal opposite obligations
real_vs_simulated.not_proven: that delivered work is good (Valun records statements, it does not judge work); that any participant will ever honour a credit note

money_view.how_to_read: hold: credit notes others issued to you that are still outstanding (what they owe you); owe: your own outstanding notes; net = hold - owe. Nothing is redeemed and PC have no value.
